title: Simple VeinMiner Pickaxe

body:
VeinMiner Netherite Pickaxe is a lightweight Paper 1.21.11 plugin that adds a powerful custom Netherite Pickaxe with built-in vein mining and tree felling abilities. When players mine a connected ore vein or chop a tree, all linked blocks are broken automatically, making resource gathering faster and smoother while still keeping survival balance intact.

The plugin is optimized for performance and uses a safe block-detection system to prevent lag or crashes, even when breaking large ore clusters or full trees. It only activates when using the special Netherite Pickaxe, ensuring players still progress through normal gameplay before unlocking its power.

Designed for survival and SMP servers, this plugin enhances mining efficiency without breaking the core Minecraft experience.

VeinPick plugin

Drop the jar into your Paper server's plugins/ folder and restart.
Get the pickaxe: /veinpick (op by default, permission veinpick.give), or craft it — 3 netherite ingots on top + 2 sticks down the middle.
Mine any ore → breaks the connected vein of the same ore. Chop any log → fells the whole tree (logs + nearby leaves).
Safety cap: 128 blocks per swing. Sneak while mining to disable vein behavior.
